notes: ciRunLines+Contains falsified by 4 inputs run in an rsync copy. (1) `echo "skipping ./scripts/check-suite-state.sh"` in a run: | block certifies the step while CI runs bare `go test ./...`; all 6 guards green, and deleting that echo turns them red. (2) `- run: |` sets blockIndent to the DASH indent, so the step's own `name:` value is swallowed as executable, certifying 2 gate steps. (3) stripShellComment truncates `echo "issue #412" && ./scripts/check-deadcode.sh`. (4) `run: |+` drops its block.

No guard sees whether a certified step executes. Measured in an rsync copy: `if: false` on the deadcode step, and `continue-on-error: true` on the suite-state step, each leave every gate guard GREEN while CI runs (or enforces) nothing. Separately, deleting the whole `if [ "$before" != "$after" ]` block from scripts/check-suite-state.sh -- the wrapper's reason to exist -- left the full internal/cli package green (42s): wrapperArgv measures the argv handed to go, never the contract.

HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".yml") skips .yaml, which GitHub Actions accepts identically; the repo already ships two workflows. Measured in an rsync copy: .github/workflows/release.yaml installing golangci-lint@latest leaves the test GREEN; the byte-identical file renamed .yml turns it RED and names the floating ref. `checked` stays Positive from ci.yml, so the guard reports it is measuring something while a whole workflow is invisible to it.
